candidates.change_summary: Removed the initialization check so SetMinSum can overwrite MinSum even after initialization by deleting the revert guard.
Negated the initialization condition so SetMinSum only sets MinSum when already initialized (revert otherwise), reversing original guard behavior.
Added an extra assignment that doubles the provided value, so MinSum is set to twice _val after the check.
Changed assignment to set MinSum to a constant 0 regardless of input when not initialized.

Moved the assignment before the initialization check so MinSum is set then possibly reverted by revert (which aborts), allowing MinSum to be set only when not reverted by revert behavior (observable difference in reverted state), effectively making the check apply after assignment.
Changed the function to allow repeated updates by removing the revert guard that prevents changes after initialization (replaces the conditional revert with a no-op).
Added an assignment that sets MinSum to zero if provided value is zero, otherwise preserves original behavior (introduces conditional branch that can change outcome).
Invert the initialization check so it reverts only when not yet initialized, allowing SetMinSum to be called only after Initialized() has been called.
Require that only non-zero values can be set for MinSum, reverting otherwise (adds an additional require that can change observed value).
Make SetMinSum double the input when assigning to MinSum (alters stored value directly).

Replace the assignment to LogFile with a call to SetMinSum, so SetLogFile no longer sets the log address but instead calls SetMinSum with the provided address cast to uint, changing observable state after the call.
Remove the assignment to LogFile so calling SetLogFile does nothing (except the initialized check), leaving LogFile unchanged.
Change assignment to LogFile to only assign when _log is not the zero address; otherwise leave LogFile unchanged, altering observable result when passing zero address.
Invert the initialized check to allow setting LogFile only when already initialized, changing when SetLogFile can modify state.
Replace the condition so incoming value is ignored when preventing overflow by removing the safe-check and directly adding msg.value to balance.
Replace the comparison so unlockTime is set to the lesser of the existing unlockTime and the new candidate time (min instead of max).
Replace the update so unlockTime is always overwritten with the new candidate time (no conditional), potentially reducing or increasing lock times.
Insert an extra log call before the state update to emit two messages per Put, changing observable logs.
Replace the LogFile message string to a different value, altering externally observable log contents after Put.
